title: Storage migration validation ignores archived event-log corruption
description: Evidence: storage-migrate validates the produced event log with verify(), which reads only the live log file; EventLog.verifyDeep() is the archive-aware validator. Impact: migration can report ok even when rotated/archive event-log segments are corrupt or missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration validation uses archive-aware verification or explicitly reports that archived segments were not checked, with a rotated-log corruption regression.
